experiments.scope: B' runs 0, 1 of pre-registration A (proof 4.2; k = 0 is the advice of the v6 full-scale run). Then trials 4..67 run one connector attempt each (cap 2^18 work units, DMIN 33) on advice k = ks[t mod 2] with coin words from the organizer seed (class Coins); PASS iff accepted and two sampled solutions satisfy Lemmas 1-2 (proof 2.5), FAIL otherwise; the facts of proof 3 for that advice are checked first. experiments.scope: The counted word-RAM programs of proof 2.1 and 2.4 (r5_trail.py): every operator on class W, load() and st() count one primitive, test() two (compare, branch); values are 256-bit words, bit p of a word belonging to pair (or leaf) p. First checks that EQS is a basis of the equations of the 10 round-2 rows. Trials t = 0, 3, ..., 21 (E): basis vectors b_0..b_31 from SHAKE-256 of the organizer seed, and x of the first message of certificate r5-v6-000038 placed at slot p (a seed byte); e_setup, then one counted batch (e_batch) and its control (e_control); PASS iff every one of the 24 equation words equals a plain evaluation of u = L(chi(L(chi(x) + RC0)) + RC1) on a third of the 256 pairs (alternating residues), slot p passes, and the counts are E_BATCH = 6,072 and E_CTRL = 40. Trials 1, 4, ..., 22 (T3): the output core; a seeded group and outer Gray position (Algorithm H walked from its start); four counted batches (t3_batch) at seeded thresholds T, each followed by a counted Gray step (gstep); PASS iff for each batch the bitsliced AS of every slot and the pass word equal a plain evaluation, the maintained base equals L^-1 of the outer rows, each batch with its Gray step counts at most T3_BATCH = 1,583, the comparison's longest path over all 513 tau classes is T3_CMP = 74, and the longest batch over all 513 tau classes (synthetic group) plus the Gray step's longest branch is T3_BATCH (1,539 + 44). Trials 2, 5, ..., 23 (T2): three counted leaves (t2_leaf) of the output core from a seeded Gray position, each with its Gray step; PASS iff each decision and the maintained digest-plane words equal a plain evaluation and each count is at most T2_LEAF = 166. Other trials return no pair. PASS = (00^135, 01||00^134) satisfies the declared event; FAIL = (00^135, 02||00^134) does not. Both are fixed sentinels (the host check is vacuous); the evidence is the organizer's execution of the visible code, and the host-counted numbers are successes (PASS) and returned_pairs (PASS + FAIL).
experiments.hypothesis: The prices of proof 6 are the counted programs' longest paths: E costs 6,112 primitives per batch of 256 pairs on every path; a T3 batch with its Gray step at most 1,583 (charged on every batch); a T2 leaf at most 166; and the programs compute the same predicates as a plain evaluation.
